Agent Name: CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a factual error in Step 3 by incorrectly identifying the C-suite members of monday.com at the time of its IPO (June 10, 2021). The agent claimed that Oren Stern (CMO), Amit Mathrani (CRO), and Michal Aharon (CPO) were not in the C-suite during the IPO. However, historical records and the company's investor relations filings confirm that Oren Stern was the Chief Marketing Officer and Amit Mathrani was the Chief Revenue Officer at the time of the IPO. While Michal Aharon (CPO) may have joined later, the exclusion of Stern and Mathrani renders the final list of individuals who "did not have a C-suite position" incorrect, as these two were indeed C-suite executives during the IPO. The error stems from relying on potentially outdated or incomplete search snippets (specifically the WSJ snippet which only listed three names) rather than verifying the full executive team composition from official IPO prospectuses or comprehensive historical databases.
